description.p: Solstice is a digital audio workstation for GNOME. Its tracks area, inspector, library, mixer and editors follow the layout and keyboard shortcuts of Logic Pro.

ul.li: Audio and software instrument tracks with low-latency input monitoring
VST3 effects and instruments, with plug-in drag and drop between channel strips
Aux buses, pre- and post-fader sends, ganged faders and drag-to-paint mute and solo
Piano roll, cycle recording, autopunch and real-time bounce
